limitations: Source object inventory, not expected Markdown or a conversion quality verdict.
Embedded-image bounds come from pdfplumber; vector/logo/table bounds are measured visually with about 3 points of tolerance.
Ten numbered figures occupy eleven raster image objects because Figure 2 continues onto page 9. They contain procedure text, not quantitative charts or cell tables.
One logical cost table spans two pages. Page-level table entries identify its two segments.
No OCR or transcription of the full raster procedure text was performed. Visible headings, structure and text-layer absence were verified.
Page 15 includes the start of a different Pilatus notice; the source PDF is not restricted to the Boeing notice.
